style: Refine every catalog object toward warm, softly lit cartoon art, consistent with the selected plant reference. Preserve identity, function and original palette family. Keep registered camera, dimensions, roots, sockets, ports, footprints and animation timing. No preferred horizontal light direction for rotatable world sprites; no directional ground shadows. Real 3D render output, editable Blender sources. The source 2D effects remain explicitly identified as 2D. Each object receives fresh independent editor/judge agents. Publish object-by-object to the same PR preview; integrate approved sprites into Godot after catalog review checks. Follow-on design exploration: improve the modeling itself, including forms, proportions, structure, crafted details and decorations. Original part counts and awkward geometry are not constraints. The editor may rebuild native geometry to achieve the better design; the judge should reward useful improvements. Preserve the locked registration, gameplay contact/clearance, animation and modular continuity contract. See modeling-policy.json version2.

criteria.success: Native geometry produces a rounded but compact coin with a readable rim thickness, distinct face/inset and a purposeful raised currency bar. No awkward flat slab, jagged rim kink, floating relief, broken silhouette or coplanar overlap in any visible phase.
criteria.freedom: Forms, proportions, topology, nonfunctional part count, rim/face construction and sparkle geometry may improve. The old 12-sided discs and beam pluses are not locks.

criteria.success: Recognizable original gold/yellow palette family, warm orange-gold side/relief depth, bright readable midtones, and contained pale highlights. The rim, coin face and bar separate at 64px/cell without an outline that becomes a dark cutout.

Broad soft light and rounded edge reflections communicate the actual volume. Balanced horizontal lighting, no directional ground shadow. No target-style single-side key copied as a rig requirement; no white highlight sheet that erases the rim or face.

A simple crafted coin construction and clean sparkle silhouettes improve polish at small scale. No reward amounts, accidental text, photo noise, unrelated prop, foliage motif, painted target card, external halo or baked directional shadow.

All required native frames and four facings preserve one-shot growth/rise/turn/collapse. No frame clipping, late midclip disappearance, flicker, material swim, black seams, blown highlight regions, unlit backs or alpha debris. Near-vanished first/last frames remain intentional. Show original-layout atlases, full canvas, logical size, 64px/cell context, light/mid/dark backgrounds, and actual temporal playback including runtime fade.

judgeProposal.approvalGate: Visible material improvement over original toward fixed target/style plus frozen functional contract. Missing required native/temporal/context evidence means needs_evidence. No score threshold grants approval.
judgeProposal.quantitativeContract: source-contract-proposal.json; all tolerances require root freeze before candidate.

coordinatorResolution.camera: Use independently restored actual asset camera, not unrelated saved active character camera. Fixed matrix, pixel aspect, ortho scale, frame/root/world scale; no fitting.
coordinatorResolution.animation: Preserve measured native emitter trajectory, phase/scale/yaw and camera-facing counterrotation. No invented full spin. Adopt proposed numeric tolerances as guardrails; all48 frames required.
coordinatorResolution.functionalEnvelope: Adopt proposed coarse union [-.32,-.225,.48] to [.455,.225,1.465] as permitted design envelope for this nonblocking feedback effect. Actual source max1.381125 is provenance; nominal1.12 is not animation ceiling. Useful rim/face/spark rebuilding allowed, no old part-count/pervertex lock.
coordinatorResolution.contextAnchor: Keep actual existing runtime registered attachment and .9s fade; do not relocate based on stale above-customer label.
coordinatorResolution.endpoint: Adopt proposed endpoint alpha-weighted area <=1% of peak plus native phase evidence and visual collapse review.
coordinatorResolution.nativeOutput: Full dimensional editable coin model. Lighting/materials may change; coherent warm soft finish without horizontal preferred lighting or directional ground shadow. Keep raw target frozen.
